Webpage text snapshot | Retrieved 10 October 2026
Iamneo Edutech Private Limited
(Last Updated: 19/11/2025)
1. Introduction
Iamneo Edutech Private Limited (“Iamneo”, “we”, “our”, “us”) is committed to protecting your personal information. This
Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, share, and safeguard your information when you use our Website,
Virtual Internship Programs, online assessments, and related services (“Services”).
By accessing our Website or enrolling in any Program, you consent to the data practices described in this Policy.
2. Information We Collect
a) Personal Information
Name
Email ID
Phone Number
Gender (optional)
Date of Birth (optional)
Address (if required for certificates or verification)
Parent/Guardian details (if user is under 18)
b) Account & Usage Data
Login details
Course progress
Task submissions
Assessment scores
Certification data
User activity logs
c) Payment Information
Payments are processed by trusted third-party payment gateways (ICICI Bank or others).
We do not store your card or banking details.
d) Technical Information
IP address
Browser type
Device details
Cookies and tracking data
3. How We Use Your Information
We use your information to:
Provide access to the Virtual Internship Program
Communicate updates, reminders, and support

Generate certificates
Process payments
Improve platform performance
Prevent fraud and misuse
Comply with legal obligations
We never sell your personal data.
4. Sharing of Information
We may share data with:
Payment gateway partners (ICICI Bank and others)
Email/SMS service providers
Cloud hosting providers
Legal authorities (only if required by law)
We do not share student data with advertisers or third parties for marketing purposes.
5. Cookies
We use cookies to improve user experience, analyze performance, and save login preferences. Users may disable
cookies via browser settings.
6. Data Retention
We store user data for as long as required to deliver the Program and for internal compliance purposes.
Upon account deletion, user data may be retained for legal or audit reasons.
7. Data Security
We implement strict security practices including:
SSL encryption
Access control
Secure login protocols
Regular audits
CERT-In aligned security checks
8. User Rights
Users may:
Request access to their data
Request corrections
Request deletion (except where legally required)
Request to stop communication
9. Contact
For any inquiries, concerns, or grievances regarding this privacy policy or our handling of your personal information,
please contact our Grievance Officer Harish. N.
Phone : 6383671311
email: iamneo.go@iamneo.ai.

1. INTRODUCTION
This Website and the Virtual Internship Programs (“Programs”) are owned and operated by iamneo Edutech Private
Limited (“Iamneo”, “we”, “our”, or “us”).
By accessing our Website, registering for a Virtual Internship Program, or using any learning material, you agree to
these Terms & Conditions (“Terms”), our Privacy Policy, and our Disclaimer Policy.
If you do not agree to these Terms, you must not use this Website or enroll in any Program.
iamneo may update or modify these Terms at any time without prior notice. Users are responsible for reviewing updated
Terms regularly.
You must be 18 years or older to enroll independently. Individuals under 18 years may enroll only with parent/guardian
supervision and consent.
iamneo reserves the right to suspend or terminate access if a user violates these Terms.
2. ABOUT THE VIRTUAL INTERNSHIP PROGRAM
The Virtual Internship Program (“Program”) is a structured online learning and project-based internship experience
provided by iamneo.
It includes:
learning modules
assignments and tasks
project submissions
assessments
mentors or automated guidance
digital certificates (based on completion criteria)
The Program does not represent or guarantee real-time employment, job placement, or physical internship with a
company.
Certificates reflect the user’s participation in iamneo’s training-based virtual internship simulation.
All Program content—videos, documents, tasks, code templates, assessments—belongs to iamneo.
3. ADDITIONAL TERMS
All personal information collected from you during registration or participation is governed by our Privacy Policy, which
forms part of these Terms.
4. GENERAL DISCLAIMERS
iamneo provides training-based virtual internship experiences for skill building and project exposure.
Information on the Website may include external references, research data, or industry information. iamneo does not
guarantee absolute accuracy or up-to-date completeness.
iamneo shall not be liable for:
delays in platform access
failure to complete tasks by the user
inability to access course modules
performance issues due to internet/connectivity problems

loss of data caused by user system/device failures
indirect, incidental, or consequential damages
Program access is non-transferable and limited strictly to the registered user.
5. THIRD-PARTY REFERENCES & EXTERNAL LINKS
Some sections of the Program may refer to external tools, documentation, or websites.
These are provided only for learning convenience.
iamneo does not control external sites and is not responsible for:
their content
availability
services
advertisements
data usage policies
6. USER RESPONSIBILITIES & CONDUCT
By enrolling in the Virtual Internship Program, you agree:
You are 18+ or have parental/guardian permission.
You will review and understand Program pricing before purchase.
You will not share your login credentials or access content with others.
You will not attempt to download, copy, resell, or distribute videos or Program content.
You will not upload or submit:
offensive
abusive
hateful
pornographic
racist
misleading
defamatory
harmful content
You will not engage in system abuse, hacking attempts, or any unauthorized access.
You will not request or share personal information with trainers, mentors, staff, or other users.
Non-compliance may result in immediate account suspension.
7. PROGRAM COMPLETION & CERTIFICATION
Certificates are issued only upon:
completing all mandatory modules
submitting projects or tasks
achieving minimum evaluation criteria
following deadlines where applicable
iamneo reserves the right to deny certification if the user:
fails to complete required tasks

violates academic integrity (copying, plagiarism, code theft, automation misuse)
Certificates are digital and non-transferable.
8. PRICING POLICY
All Program prices are subject to change without notice due to:
content updates
market changes
partner changes
technical errors
The price paid at the time of purchase remains valid for that Program’s duration.
9. PAYMENTS & PAYMENT GATEWAY
All online payments are securely processed through the ICICI Bank Payment Gateway or other authorized providers.
iamneo does not store credit/debit card details.
In case of payment failure, please directly contact your bank or payment provider.
10. REFUND & CANCELLATION POLICY
Refunds are permitted only under the following conditions:
Refund requests must be made within 7 days of purchase.
Products purchased under discounts of 50% or more are not eligible for refunds.
Products purchased during promotional or festive sales (Diwali, Pongal, New Year, Christmas, etc.) are non-refundable.
Virtual Internship Programs, Crash Courses, Mock Test Series, and Short-Duration Packs are non-refundable.
If partially dissatisfied with a specific module, partial refunds may be considered on a case-by-case basis.
40% cancellation charges may apply where eligible.
Certificates will not be issued for users requesting refunds.
Refund decisions by iamneo are final and binding.
11. TERMINATION OF ACCOUNT
iamneo reserves the right to terminate or restrict access if:
the user violates these Terms
fraudulent activity is suspected
the user engages in misuse of the program or content
the user attempts unauthorized sharing or downloading
Upon termination:
all access to Program content stops immediately
iamneo is not obligated to retain user data
12. PROHIBITED ACTIVITIES
Users must not:
use the platform for unlawful purposes
attempt to reverse engineer or hack the Website
inject malicious code, viruses, or scripts
share copyrighted material

impersonate iamneo staff or mislead other users
use the Program for commercial training or resale
Violations may result in legal action.
13. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS
All content including:
videos
learning materials
projects
assessment tools
code templates
documentation
graphics
brand assets
are the exclusive property of iamneo Edutech Private Limited.
Users have a limited, non-transferable, non-exclusive license to access Program content only for personal learning.
Any attempt to copy, mirror, publish, distribute, or resell content will be treated as a violation and may invite legal action.
14. JURISDICTION & GOVERNING LAW
These Terms are governed by the laws of India.
Any disputes shall fall under the exclusive jurisdiction of courts in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu.
15. MISCELLANEOUS
These Terms constitute the entire agreement between the user and iamneo.
If any clause becomes invalid, the remaining Terms continue to apply.
iamneo may update content, modules, or platform features without prior notice.
Users must follow all applicable laws while using the platform.
